gripOrHq.title: Corporate Shuffle
gripOrHq.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

gripOrHq.title: Project Venice
gripOrHq.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

gripOrHq.title: Bug Zapper
gripOrHq.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Reclamation
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

scoreArea.title: Security Purge
scoreArea.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

rig.title: Joan of Arc
rig.rulesText:
[T]: Prevent one or more of your other installed programs from being trashed.
[1]: Prevent one or more of your other installed programs from being trashed, and bring Joan of Arc into your hand.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Top Runners' Conference
rig.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

ice.title: Chihuahua
ice.rulesText: *Trace 1-If trace is successful, do 1 Net damage. Gain [2] when you rez Chihuahua.

ice.title: Chihuahua
ice.rulesText: *Trace 1-If trace is successful, do 1 Net damage. Gain [2] when you rez Chihuahua.

ice.title: Puzzle
ice.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

ice.title: Puzzle
ice.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

ice.title: Colonel Failure
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *End the run. *End the run.

root.title: Syd Meyer Superstores
root.rulesText: A: Trash a rezzed piece of ice. Gain [4].
